stories.title: [RIZIN] Sho Patrick Usami "I don't know if I'll continue doing martial arts or not, but if I do, I'll just do it as a heel." "Is there anyone in Japan who would boo you that much?"
stories.originalTitle: 【RIZIN】宇佐美正パトリック「格闘技をこれからも続けるか続けへんか分からないけど、やるんやったらこのままヒールで」「日本であれだけブーイングならせる人いますか？」
stories.excerpt: 2026年10月3日（土）長崎スタジアムシティHAPPINESS ARENAにて『 RIZIN LANDMARK 16 in NAGASAKI 』が開催された。 第10試合の72.65kg契約5分3Rで、堀江圭功（ALLIANCE）に2R3分32秒、TKO負けした宇佐美正パトリック（Battle-Box）が試合後インタビューに答えた。 1.65kgの体重超過した理由と、会場に鳴り響いたブーイングについて語った。 あんなんできんのも才能やと思う ――試合を終えた今の率直な気持ちを教えてください。 「気持ち的には別に何も…。あまり試合の記憶がなくて。それだけアドレナリンが出すぎてかあまり覚えてないですね。でもやる気はあったし、盛り上がったんじゃないかなって。違う部分を見せられたかなって思っています」

stories.title: [RIZIN] Yoshinori Horie won hard in the main event. ``It's great to clear things up.'' To the loud cheers from the locals, ``It feels like we're all going to fight together. That's the kind of spirit we want to fight.'' From now on, ``I want to fight against opponents who can step up.''

stories.excerpt: Starting Sunday, October 4, 2026, the kickboxing festival GOAT's regular program ``Let's Kick GOAT ~Mirai's Fighting Entertainment~'' will begin broadcasting every Sunday evening from 6:00pm to 6:30pm on 6 TV Tokyo network stations nationwide. This program is a fun way for families to learn about dreams and lessons through kickboxing, and features comedian Rainbow, talent Ayaka Hombo, and former kickboxer Takeru Takeru. The first broadcast will feature Ryuusei (BRAID/TEAM SUERTE), who will be making his first defense of the ISKA K-1 Rules World Super Featherweight Championship at Kickboxing Fest.3 "GOAT" to be held at TV Tokyo's Tennozu Studio on Sunday, October 25th. In the program, talent Sawa, who is a supporter of GOAT, directly interviews Ryuusei at the gym, and Ryuusei himself also appears in the gym.

stories.excerpt: November 8, 2026 (Sunday) Korakuen Hall, Tokyo A press conference to announce the match card for ``RISE 203'' was held in Tokyo on October 2nd (Friday). The main card will be the 5th RISE super flyweight (-53kg) title deciding match between 1st place in the class, Hitoshi Mandokoro (Kaijuku) and 2nd place in the class, Kazushima Taiki (Oikawa Dojo), in 3 minutes, 5 rounds and 1 round of extra time. Mandokoro used his fast-spinning strikes, also known as the Vulcan Cannon, and techniques to surprise his opponents, to defeat many strong opponents and win the J-NETWORK Flyweight Championship and the WBKF World Super Flyweight Championship. He won the "RISE NEW WARRIORS Tournament" in November 2023 by KOing Ryu Hanaoka in the semifinals and defeating Kaito Hasegawa in the final. He had a title match with Kazuki Osaki in June 2024, but lost by decision. In December, he competed against Hanaoka for the 3rd RISE Super Flyweight Championship, but lost by decision.
